Spawn subagent with context fork - clone parent session state into child, selective context injection, parent-child relationship tracking
Spawn subagent with fresh context - zero-context launch with explicit context bundle, no inherited state leakage
Multi-provider subagent routing - spawn children on different providers/models than parent, per-child model override
Resume failed subagent - restore session state from last checkpoint, continue from failure point, preserve partial results
Retry with exponential backoff - classify error (transient/permanent), backoff schedule, jitter, max retries, circuit breaker
Change model mid-session - hot-swap provider/model for running subagent without losing context, model fallback chain
Subagent context compression - automatic context compaction when approaching token limit, configurable compression strategy
Structured handoff protocol - serialize subagent state to handoff document, transfer to new agent with fidelity guarantees
Auto context compression toggle - settings-driven automatic compression, threshold config, compression quality metrics
Dedicated subagent settings page - UI/config section for max concurrent, default model, retry policy, compression, timeout, budget per child
Subagent pool manager - maintain N running agents, auto-replace finished/failed, work queue drain, pool scaling
Subagent observability - live status dashboard, token usage per child, cost tracking, latency percentiles, error rates
Subagent permission inheritance - child inherits parent permissions with optional restriction, no privilege escalation
Subagent output aggregation - collect and merge results from parallel children, conflict resolution, dedup
Subagent cancellation and cleanup - cancel running children, reclaim resources, cleanup worktrees, release locks
Dangerous shell-pattern denylist stripped at auto-entry - cross-platform code-exec block plus matcher tests
Execpolicy prefix rules - declarative path and command allowlist, longest-match evaluated before tools
Bounded hook bus - max 100 pending with shift-drop, always-emit allowlist, SSRF guard on HTTP hooks
Turn submission state machine - submit to running to interrupted or complete as typed transitions with cancel cleanup
Dual rollout record - append-only JSONL is truth, sqlite holds queryable snapshot, recorder owns order
Content-addressed transcript dedupe - repeated prompts and tool schemas stored by canonical hash, turns reference ids
Provider-boundary tap with redaction - uid-keyed structured records at request, response, stream-final, error seam
Debug export bundle - one redacted JSONL with session meta, deduped defs, turns, timings, errors; offline renderer
Doctor diagnostics command - checks auth, connectivity, tools, MCP; reports failures without log spelunking
Skill safe extraction - bundled files materialize once, owner-only 0600 O_EXCL O_NOFOLLOW, traversal rejected
Fork boundary is typed - branch copy only on fork, cache cleared at boundary
Revert is free pointer move distinct from truncating rollback with separate API names
Auto-compact thresholds plus warning states plus 3-strike circuit breaker with env kill-switches
Cheap-model chores routing - quota, topic, title, summarize go to cheapest capable model, fail-open
Plan mode plus structured review child - plan permission mode with Enter and Exit tools, review returns machine-checkable findings
Per-turn cost counters - input, output, cache-read, cache-create, durations, lines changed, web-search count, unknown-cost flag
TUI composer - multiline editor, Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, Ctrl+J fallback, send button, draft survives interrupt, queue-while-busy
TUI status bar - clickable model item opens provider-aware switcher, clickable context item opens context detail view; keyboard fallback
TUI context detail view - per-source token breakdown with cache-read vs fresh flags, largest blocks first, truncation markers
TUI /memory viewer - list loaded memory files with path bytes tokens cached flag, unload with prefix-cache cost warning, reload path
TUI keybindings help - footer hints plus /keybindings parity, configurable composer submit keymap
Shared singleton daemon and embedded web host - web, future TUI and CLI use one per-user/data-dir native backend authority without a separate web-only serve process
Full-width role-aligned transcript rows with request/response action bars below each message and honest capability-gated actions
Real edit, retry, regenerate and branch/fork actions preserve original conversation history and expose branch navigation

Structured assistant turns render collapsed provider reasoning summaries and tool activity separately from final answer text with a dedicated references section; raw hidden chain-of-thought is never exposed
Accessible WYSIWYG structured chat composer with model and effort controls, slash commands, mentions, attachment/tool/plugin affordances, drafts and stop/queue/steer state
Real bounded files, images and screenshots through picker, paste, drag/drop and a searchable local Library with native attachment-provider mapping
Composer plugin, app and tool discovery/selection backed by real native capabilities with permission approvals and durable tool-call results
Search and deep-research mode with real source/tool selection, reviewable plan, progress, steering, cancellation and cited final results
Chat navigation parity with pins, unified history search, archive/share, temporary chat, progressive long-history paging and keyboard navigation
Projects and workspaces group chats, files and reusable context with memory/context inspection and disclosure of sources used
Voice and dictation with explicit microphone state, visible transcript and a real native audio/realtime adapter
Editable writing and code artifacts with copy/edit/undo/preview and explicitly authorized safe run/apply actions
Provider auth profile model with explicit auth provenance - API key, official OAuth, imported local credential, and keyring-backed states; never log or serialize token material
Official OpenAI Codex OAuth connector - browser/device login, refresh lifecycle, logout, account status, and provider-native model routing without impersonation headers
Official Anthropic Claude Code OAuth connector - PKCE/loopback consent flow, refresh lifecycle, logout, account status, and provider-native model routing without impersonation headers

Consent-based local credential import - read Codex ~/.codex/auth.json and Claude Code ~/.claude/.credentials.json or configured directories, validate schema and permissions, copy into protected storage without exposing tokens

Provider request profiles - use documented API authentication and required headers, explicit provider identity, bounded retries/timeouts, and redacted wire diagnostics; prohibit CLI impersonation and detection-evasion headers
Auth connector commands and status surface - connect/login, import, list, inspect, refresh, logout; show provider, account, auth mode, expiry, and actionable errors without secret material
Provider usage and limits telemetry - current model/provider, auth source, request count, input/output tokens, cost when available, rate-limit/reset metadata, and bounded status-panel snapshots
Auth storage hardening - OS keyring when available, 0600 file fallback, atomic refresh persistence, path allowlist, no inherited secrets, and deterministic redacted diagnostics

Provider compatibility catalog - versioned documentation-backed records for supported official auth flows, endpoints, required headers, model aliases, refresh behavior, and known limitations with source dates
Differential provider contract fixtures - offline request-shape and auth-state tests for OpenAI, Anthropic, and other supported providers, with secret redaction and no live credential use

Right-side TUI information panel with bounded live metadata: current directory, workspace/session, provider/model/auth mode, context usage, tokens, cost, MCP counts, active tools, queue state, timestamps and warnings; redact secrets and support narrow terminals
MCP catalog search at top of MCP list using a versioned source-attributed popular-library index; search names, descriptions and tags with bounded results and safe install metadata
MCP selection and bulk actions with keyboard/mouse selection, select-all/clear/invert, enable/disable/remove/refresh/install, bounded selection and confirmations for destructive actions
Per-MCP power toggle and lifecycle state with enabled/disabled/starting/ready/error, persistence, reconnect and refresh; off means no tool registration or invocation
MCP payload filtering excludes disabled MCP servers and tools from message payloads and execution lookup, with deterministic snapshots and no stale enabled state
MCP state integration into the right-side info panel and status events with bounded updates, counts, active tools, last error and latency, without blocking agent turns
Versioned sync log with monotonic sequence allocation per aggregate, idempotent apply, projector registry, post-freeze definition rejection, deterministic replay.
Persisted message/part create-update-remove events versus ephemeral part-deltas; deltas never persist/replay; late foreign-key update warns without duplicating.
Per-session single normal runner: second prompt gets typed BusyError with zero side effects; shell lane runs concurrently; cancel reclaims task and removes idle runner.
ACP v1 JSONL framing over caller-supplied byte streams: initialize, session new/load/prompt, modes/models/variants; malformed frame rejected without state change.
ACP text-file read/write with byte caps; unsupported full update stream, tool-call reporting, mode switch, auth, real terminal, full history restore return typed Unsupported.
Workspace HTTP/WS proxy strips hop/routing headers, bounded queue-until-open, bridges /__workspace_ws, routes local versus remote by directory.
Remote workspace SSE sync loop with connected/connecting/disconnected/error statuses, bounded reconnect backoff, disposal closes queue/socket.
Typed SDK client with directory header/query rewriting, abort/timeout propagation, typed decode errors, no process spawn.
SDK server/process/TUI spawners with owned child lifecycle, single owner, kill-on-drop, no detached tasks, bounded startup timeout.
Headless run execution with inline/block renderers, attachment conversion, bounded output, typed exit codes, uncompressed prompt streaming.
Session export to caller-supplied writer as redacted JSON with explicit session id, no interactive picker in non-TTY, byte cap, no secret bytes.
